name: OriginTrail DKG for Obsidian
description: Obsidian plugin that syncs Markdown notes from a local-first vault into a local OriginTrail DKG v10 node as structured, linked knowledge. Notes stay private in Working Memory by default; selected notes are shared per-note or per-folder into collaborative projects via Shared Memory. Talks to the node over the HTTP API only.

install.oneLiner: Copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into <vault>/.obsidian/plugins/origintrail-dkg/ (or run `make install VAULT=...`), enable it in Obsidian, then run the setup wizard to enter your DKG node URL and auth token.

writeAuthority: POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/swm/share [Curator-authority: SHARE, WM to SWM; only on an explicit per-note/per-folder share, never automatically]
security.notes: Communicates only with the local DKG node (default http://127.0.0.1:9200); no external network egress. The DKG auth token is entered in plugin settings and stored only in the vault's local plugin data; it is sent only as a Bearer header to the local node. Notes are written to Working Memory via knowledge-assets wm/import-file and semantic-enrichment/write. The only Curator-authority SHARE is POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/swm/share (WM to SWM), invoked only on an explicit user action (sharing a note to a project, or a folder rule the user configured); never automatically and never to Verified Memory. Membership operations (approve-join / reject-join / add-participant / remove-participant) are Curator-authority and run only when the user manages their own project. No Verified Memory (PUBLISH) operations. Distributed as an Obsidian plugin (prebuilt main.js / manifest.json / styles.css committed to the repo), not an npm or docker package, so there are no install/preinstall/postinstall scripts; install is manual.

promotionPath: Each note is imported into the vault's private Working Memory context graph as an assertion, then enriched with resolved-wikilink and filename-title triples (provenance-tagged) so the graph stays connected. A note matures to Shared Memory only on an explicit user action - 'Share current note to a project' or a folder-to-project rule - which calls POST /api/knowledge-assets/{name}/swm/share to gossip its triples into the project's Shared Memory for subscribed members. Verified Memory is intentionally out of scope for this beta; assertions keep stable assertion URIs (UALs) so a future Curator PUBLISH step could anchor team-validated notes on-chain without reshaping the data, at which point they become oracle-consumable.
fitNotes: Obsidian is where a large existing community already authors personal knowledge. This is the human-authoring on-ramp to the DKG: it turns each user's vault into queryable, provenance-aware WM/SWM that teammates and AI agents (via the same node's HTTP/MCP surface) can discover and build on - complementing the agent/CLI/MCP-authored entries already in the registry. The per-note private-to-shared gradient the user controls maps directly onto the WM-to-SWM trust gradient of the LLM-Wiki / autoresearch model.
